evidence.title: Think with Structured Grounding: Perceptual Reinforcement Learning for Chart and Visual-Tabular Understanding

summary: Researchers introduce 'Think with Structured Grounding,' a perceptual reinforcement learning method to improve AI's ability to interpret charts and visual-tabular data. The technique leverages structured representations to enhance accuracy and contextual understanding.
title: New AI Approach Enhances Chart and Visual-Tabular Understanding Through Structured Grounding
